title: Cookbook:Black Bean Chili
wikitext:
{{recipesummary|category=Chili recipes|servings=12 persons|time=4 hours|difficulty=3}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:beans|Beans]] | [[Cookbook:Chili|Chili]]

==Ingredients==

* 3½ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]]s (8 [[Cookbook:Deciliter|dL]]) dried [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]] 
* 2 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoon]]s (30 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Corn Oil|corn oil]] or other [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:clove|cloves]] [[Cookbook:garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Chipotle Pepper|chipotle]] chile
* ¼ ancho [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile]]
* 1 tablespoon (15 mL) [[Cookbook:cumin|cumin]]
* 1 tablespoon (15 mL) [[Cookbook:paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tablespoon (15 mL) dried [[Cookbook:oregano|oregano]]
* ¾ tablespoon (11 mL) sea [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]] (1 mL) [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 2 tablespoons (30 mL) wine [[Cookbook:vinegar|vinegar]] (red or white)
* 1½ cups (350 mL) diced [[Cookbook:tomato|tomato]]es
* 1½ cups (350 mL) [[Cookbook:tomato|tomato]] puree
* 4 cups (1 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]]) [[Cookbook:water|water]]
* [[Cookbook:sour cream|Sour cream]] for [[Cookbook:garnish|garnish]]

==Procedure==

# Place beans in a large pot, add with enough water to cover by 2 [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] (2.5 cm), and allow to soak overnight. Drain beans and cover again with fresh water. Bring to [[Cookbook:boil|boil]], reduce heat, and [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] for 2 hours.
# Heat the corn oil in a stockpot or other very large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions and [[Cookbook:saute|sauté]] until tender, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, chipotle and ancho chiles, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, cayenne, and vinegar, and sauté for 5 to 10 minutes.
# Add tomatoes, tomato puree, and the water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the beans with their juice. Simmer for 1 hour.
# Serve with or without sour cream.
